transcript.name: Marcus Webb
transcript.text: Enough back-and-forth. We need a single pitch, and we need to call who's running it. If anyone disagrees, speak up—otherwise, we're wasting time and risking everyone's job. Let's settle this right now.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: Alright, we need to make a call. If nobody else wants to lead this, I can take point, but if someone feels they should, say so now. Either way, I think we have to agree as a group—otherwise, someone else will do it for us.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: Okay, if Todd's good to take point, fine by me. But can we just clarify—what's the main thing we're pitching? I want to be sure we all mean the same thing before we call it agreed.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: I agree with Amitesh. Before we say yes to anything, can someone sum up in one or two sentences what exactly we're pitching? I just want to be sure we're on the same page.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Could someone just sum up our pitch in one or two sentences? I think it’ll help if we’re all clear before we decide on anything else.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: Alright, just to be clear—are we pitching that our team can deliver more reliable fulfillment and faster turnaround than the other group, thanks to our process improvements this quarter? That’s what I’ve got, but someone correct me if I’m off.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Sorry, just want to double-check—are we all saying our pitch is about delivering faster and more reliably because of the process changes? If someone could sum it up in a sentence, I’d appreciate it.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Just to confirm, are we only focusing on the process improvements, or is there anything else we should add? I’m fine with what’s been said, just want to be sure.

transcript.name: Anna Kovačević
transcript.text: Okay. In one line: our pitch is that we deliver faster and more reliably now, thanks to real changes in our process this quarter. Todd, you’re ready to lead? If everyone’s clear, can we say it’s agreed?

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: Just one thing—do we want to mention any specific process changes, or give an example? I think it helps show exactly how we got more reliable, not just fast. Otherwise, I’m okay with what’s been said.

transcript.name: Marcus Webb
transcript.text: Look, we keep repeating ourselves. Our pitch is simple: we deliver faster and more reliably, period. That's because of process changes we actually made—like automating the order routing and dropping that old approval bottleneck. If anyone's got a real objection, say it now. Otherwise, we're done.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: That works for me. Unless someone feels we missed something, I’d say let’s go with it.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: I’m good with that. We say what we do, and why it’s working. If everyone’s clear, I say we call it and get to work.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: That lines up for me. I’m good with Todd leading. Let’s move on unless there’s anything major we’ve missed.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: Sounds good to me. I don't have anything else to add.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: Sounds good from my side. I’m in.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: I’m good with it, too. Todd can take the lead. Unless anyone else has concerns, I say we go ahead.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Okay, I’m good with Todd leading and the pitch as we’ve summed it up. No more questions from me.

transcript.name: Marcus Webb
transcript.text: Good. That's settled. Todd, it's yours. If anybody second-guesses this later, speak up now or keep it to yourself. Otherwise, let's get moving.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: No concerns from me. Let’s just keep each other posted if anything changes.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: Alright, I’ll get started on our summary for leadership and loop everyone in by the end of the day. If something comes up, just let me know directly.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: All good with me. Just ping if you need anything from my side, Todd.
